author: KEXP
description:
Multidisciplinary artist Ya Tseen crafts an immersive sonic tapestry textured with rock, pop, experimental, folk, and disco on his latest release ‘Stand On My Shoulders.’ Immersing listeners in his deep connection to his ancestry, Ya Tseen shares a performance of “Taste on My Lips” and more Live on KEXP.

Watch his full in-studio session on our listener-powered YouTube channel.
title: Ya Tseen - "Taste on My Lips" Live on KEXP
